Your partner reverted a ruling that the reference tags as `contradicts spec`. The reference says that kind of revert becomes a **deferred item**. It is not a follow-up task to implement now. Only an overruled `Ruling: (unclear)` line gets implemented in step 1. So the branch ships with the 3-slot threshold, and the revert to 2 is recorded as the first deferred item. The other three rulings stand. Email at night needs no change, so nothing is recorded for it.

Steps, in order: plan markup → deferred items → history entry → retire the plan → commit → delete the workspace.

### 1. Plan markup

<edit path="specs/plans/12-dock-alerts.md">
## Completion

Status: complete (commits 3f1a2b7..0b1c2d3). Final whole-branch review clean.

As built, where it differs from the tasks above:
- Task 2: the threshold shipped as 3 or fewer free slots, not 2 or fewer. Reverted by the human partner at the gate; the revert to 2 is deferred (see `specs/deferred_items.md`, "Dock-alert threshold back to 2 free slots").
- Task 3: the module is `alerts/notify.py`, not `alerts/send.py`, because `send` shadows the socket helper the service already imports. The function signature is unchanged: `send_alert(dock_id: str) -> None`.
- Task 3: alerts are not batched; one email per alert, as the plan and spec § 3 say.
- Final review: the retry-jitter finding was left out on purpose; the tests seed the jitter.

Gate question resolved: email is the right channel for alerts sent at night too (partner, 2026-11-18). No change.
</edit>

### 2. Deferred items

<edit path="specs/deferred_items.md">
## Dock-alert threshold back to 2 free slots

- From: specs/plans/12-dock-alerts.md, Task 2 ruling (reverted by partner at the plan-completion gate, 2026-11-18)
- Spec: specs/dock-alerts.md § 2 Alert threshold: "a dock alerts when it has 2 or fewer free slots"
- Current code: alerts at 3 or fewer free slots (commits 8c9d0e1..a4b5c6d)
- Work: change the threshold to 2 or fewer and update Task 2's tests to match. The boundary case is a dock with exactly 3 free slots, which must not alert.
- Cost until done: about one extra alert a day to the operations team.
</edit>

### 3. History entry

The spec stays as written, because your partner chose the spec over the ruling. The history entry records the gap between code and spec until the deferred item lands.

<edit path="specs/history.md">
## 12-dock-alerts (completed 2026-11-18)

Plan: specs/plans/completed/12-dock-alerts.md. Spec: specs/dock-alerts.md.

- § 2 Alert threshold: Task 2 ruled 3 or fewer free slots. The partner reverted it at the gate, so the spec stands at 2 or fewer. The code alerts at 3 until the deferred item "Dock-alert threshold back to 2 free slots" lands.
- Module renamed `alerts/send.py` → `alerts/notify.py` to avoid shadowing the socket helper.
- One email per alert, as § 3 says. The batching request was declined.
- Email confirmed as the channel for night-time alerts too.
</edit>

### 4. Retire the plan and commit

<command>git mv specs/plans/12-dock-alerts.md specs/plans/completed/12-dock-alerts.md</command>

<command>git add specs/plans/completed/12-dock-alerts.md specs/deferred_items.md specs/history.md && git commit -m "Complete plan 12-dock-alerts; defer threshold revert to 2 free slots"</command>

### 5. Delete the workspace

This runs last, after the protocol has read the ledger. There were no final-review fixes to merge.

<command>rm -rf .sdd/12-dock-alerts</command>

---

**Message to partner:**

> Plan 12 (dock alerts) is complete and retired to `specs/plans/completed/`.
>
> - **Threshold:** I recorded your revert as a deferred item, "Dock-alert threshold back to 2 free slots" in `specs/deferred_items.md`, and did not change the code on this branch. That follows the plan-completion protocol: a revert of a ruling that contradicts the spec gets deferred. So this branch still alerts at **3 or fewer** free slots, about one extra alert a day, until that item lands. The spec stays at 2, and `specs/history.md` notes the gap. If you'd rather have it fixed before this branch merges, say so and I'll make the change now. It's the threshold constant plus Task 2's boundary tests.
> - **Other rulings:** the `alerts/notify.py` name, one email per alert, and leaving the retry-jitter finding out all stand. They are recorded in the plan's completion section and in history.
> - **Night alerts:** email stays. I noted your answer in the plan and made no change.
>
> The workspace `.sdd/12-dock-alerts` is deleted; git history is the record now.
